# build-src: the sources of the Brightyard sites

Everything the live sites serve is **generated** from this folder. Edit here, run the build, commit both the sources and the generated files.

```bash
cd build-src
```

```bash
npm install
```

```bash
python3 build.py
```

Without `npm install` the build still works; it keeps the committed 3D bundle, vendor files and fonts instead of refreshing them.

## What the build writes (do not edit these by hand)

| Output | From |
|---|---|
| `index.html` | `old/body.html` + the hero, product stories and signature layer assembled in `build.py`; parts of the very first site are read from git commit `56db1cb` |
| `assets/css/site.css` | `src/fonts.css` + `old/old.css` + `old/sig.css` + `src/new.css` + `src/glass.css` |
| `assets/js/app.js` | `old/script0.js`, `old/script1.js` (part), `old/script3.js`, `old/script6.js` with `src/bpui.js` spliced in, `src/lead.js`, `src/core.js`, `src/a11y.js`, `src/megamenu.js`. Each part runs inside its own try/catch |
| `assets/js/blueprint-engine.js`, `assets/js/blueprint-brief.js` | `src/engine.js`, `src/brief.js` |
| `assets/js/scenes.js` | `src/scenes.js` bundled with three.js by esbuild |
| `functions/` | `src/functions/`, plus `functions/_lib/{engine,brief,master}.js` generated by `tools/build-functions.mjs` |
| `schema.sql`, `wrangler.example.toml` | `src/` |
| `sites/allocivo/`, `sites/xessly/` | `src/products.py`, which cuts the product sections out of the finished `index.html` |

The blueprint master data (categories, problems, plans, activities) is `src/master.json`, embedded in `index.html` as `<script id="bp-master">`.

## Two spliced files

`resplice.py` (run by the build) rebuilds two files from their parts. Edit the parts, not the results:

- `src/scenes.js` = everything above the `/* YARDIE` marker, then `src/buddy-part.js` (Yardie), then `src/model-part.js` (the 3D solution model).
- `src/bpui.js`: the block from `/* ---------- holographic result` up to `function reveal(bp,t){` is replaced by `src/model-ui.js`.

## Checks before pushing

- `npm run test:engine`: the 66 example briefs (from the repository root, `npm test` does the same).
- `node --check ../assets/js/app.js`
- Browser tests in `tests/` (Playwright plus axe-core). They expect local servers and write screenshots to `tests/out/` (create it first):
  - main site: `python3 -m http.server 8080` in the repository root
  - main site with the API: `npx wrangler pages dev . --port 8788` (copy `wrangler.example.toml` to `wrangler.toml` first; emails are logged, not sent)
  - product sites: `python3 -m http.server 8091` in `sites/allocivo`, `8092` in `sites/xessly`

| Test | Checks |
|---|---|
| `audit.js` | every main-site page on desktop and phone: script errors, failed requests, sideways scroll, visible placeholders, axe WCAG 2.2 AA |
| `contrast.js`, `menu-axe.js`, `hidden-text.js` | contrast details, contrast inside the open menus, text stuck invisible after animations |
| `kbd3.js` | yard menu and phone menu keyboard handling |
| `mega-test.js` | mega menu: hover intent, product cards, Yardie service router, sending a brief |
| `twin3-test.js` | home "Our products" cards and their narrated tabs |
| `model-test.js` | blueprint generator: the four chapters of the 3D solution model (`B=2,4` picks example briefs, `M=1` phone) |
| `lead-test.js` | email pack and engineer review dialog, share link (needs the API on 8788) |
| `forms-test.js` | contact form (needs the API on 8788) |
| `ps-test.js` | all eight product-site pages |
| `switch-test.js` | main-site product links go to the subdomains |
| `func-test.js` | older general test; its Allocivo part no longer applies now that product pages live on the subdomains |
| `weight.js` | what a first visit downloads |
